title: AI for green multi-cluster: Intelligent management towards green and low-carbon, large-scale multi-clusters
summary: TeleAI describes reinforcement-learning scheduling and LLM assistance for computing clusters; separate GPU-virtualization gains are not rated as AI benefits.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The source describes learned scheduling, including reinforcement-learning agents and LLM explanations, to improve computing-resource allocation. Its reported 150% increase in GPU availability comes from virtualization and resource sharing, and it does not establish that AI produced that gain. The AI benefit retained here is the intended improvement in scheduling and energy use. The virtualization and conventional optimization results do not determine its depth.
purpose: Use learned scheduling and model-generated assistance to improve cluster resource decisions.
system: AI for green multi-cluster: Intelligent management towards green and low-carbon, large-scale multi-clusters
developer: Institute of Artificial Intelligence (TeleAI), China Telecom

ratings.reason: Improved AI scheduling is intended. The 150% GPU-availability gain is attributed to virtualization/resource sharing and does not establish the depth of the AI benefit.
Lower emissions from AI-assisted scheduling are intended; no attributable carbon reduction is reported.

ai_role.statement: Reinforcement-learning agents learn scheduling policies; LLMs are intended to explain or assist scheduling decisions.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 8: AI for green multi-cluster: Intelligent management towards green and low-carbon, large-scale multi-clusters

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: AI scheduling research targets greener computing clusters

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
